resources.string: Keep your copy with your contacts?

Your copy lives only on phones, never in a cloud: this is Montana\'s own way of keeping it. It is sealed with your 24 words and cut into parts, and the people you write to keep the parts for you: each sees only a size, never a word. On a new phone your 24 words bring the parts back, and your conversations with them. In the same way this phone keeps sealed parts for your contacts, up to 1 GB, and cannot open them. Both switches are in Settings → Data and Storage.

Take my copy back from my contacts

The parts your contacts leave with you are sealed the same way: this phone cannot open them, and only their own 24 words can. This is how Montana keeps copies with no cloud in between: people hold each other\'s sealed parts, and no one but the owner can ever read them.
